Introduction

MY ONE is an upcoming five-member boy group under Startree Entertainment. The group first gained attention on February 3, 2025, when Startree released both group and individual profile photos, officially introducing the members ahead of their debut. While the debut date has not yet been announced, anticipation is growing due to the members’ diverse backgrounds. Member Hiro previously promoted under the name Hwan as part of Road Boyz and AQA, while Scene was active in the Japanese boy groups SKYXROS and SAFIRE under the name Ryushin.
